Soccer: shown only after a completed match that a penalty shootout decided (level after play); shootoutAScore/shootoutBScore keep the kicks scored.

Table tennis, pickleball: side A has game point (the side split of isGamePoint: A leads the game in play and one point wins it; off at match point, like isGamePoint). Volleyball: side A has set point (also at match point, like isGamePoint; at a point cap both sides can). Off between games or sets and once the match is complete. Follows switched ends and a flipped court-side board like the other A/B flags.

Table tennis, pickleball, volleyball: side A has match point (the side split of isMatchPoint: one more point wins the game or set and with it the match). Off between games or sets and once the match is complete. Follows switched ends and a flipped court-side board like the other A/B flags.

Table tennis, pickleball: side B has game point (the side split of isGamePoint: B leads the game in play and one point wins it; off at match point, like isGamePoint). Volleyball: side B has set point (also at match point, like isGamePoint; at a point cap both sides can). Off between games or sets and once the match is complete. Follows switched ends and a flipped court-side board like the other B/A flags.
